variants.headline: Party leader faces a challenge
variants.sub: A challenge to a party leader has opened in the colony.
variants.body:
A party's leader is being challenged in {colony}. The challenge places authority within the organisation in question, without deciding who should exercise it. Readers assessing {target} should distinguish the opening of a contest from an outcome that has not been established by this report.

A leadership challenge can attract considerable political attention without establishing any change in policy. Business readers should separate an internal question of authority from an economic decision. The possibility of a new spokesperson is not evidence of a specific future rule, commitment or commercial condition for the colony.

Our assessment of {target} is critical. Political leadership should withstand serious questioning, and an internal challenge is no reason to suspend the demanding standards that public responsibility properly requires. Reliable assessment begins with particulars rather than a politically convenient assumption.
